amendment.scope: Prevent the checkpoint-only parallel large-file mode from leaking into the nested four-file data-order sidecar copy.
amendment.observed_failure: The seed1002 primary materializer verified and atomically installed all 19 checkpoint-tree files, then exited before sidecar validation because the inherited acceleration flag made the sidecar copier require three nonexistent model files.
amendment.repair: Set SYNC_PARALLEL_LARGE_FILES=0 only for the nested data-order sidecar sync invocation.
amendment.checkpoint_reuse: A retry verifies and reuses the already installed complete checkpoint destination, then resumes initialization and data-order sidecar materialization.
amendment.integrity: Remote and local SHA-256 verification, atomic destination replacement, normalized sidecar validation, and the joint nine-arm integrity gate remain unchanged.
